mechanism.claim: A high-variation completed eight-hour BTC path with unusually few intrinsic-time directional reversals represents a coherent auction rather than threshold-scale whipsaw. When the full block and final two hours agree and exact 24-hour open interest has expanded, follow that sponsored direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed eight-hour return and final-two-hour return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVDCS runs one threshold state machine on the completed log-close path and counts only reversals that exceed one block-RMS return. The prior dual-intrinsic-clock search compared price and flow event clocks; sign-run and Lempel-Ziv candidates discretize every minute; HVAUD tracks running-extrema duration. HVDCSOIS adds only exact decision-available 24-hour Binance OI expansion to the frozen HVDCS geometry and uses no volume, funding, cross-assets, fitted outcomes, prior event rows, or promoted controls.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the causal variation tail selects volatile blocks, the low reversal-count tail requires coherent intrinsic-time movement, and rising 24-hour OI identifies leverage sponsorship rather than exhaustion
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: the conjunction of fixed-UTC intrinsic-time reversal scarcity and exact 24-hour OI sponsorship is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 480 exact coherent BTCUSDT bars_binance interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
features.directional_change_threshold: sqrt(mean(r_i squared)); strict positive and fixed for the completed block
features.state_machine: start unconfirmed at the first log close; confirm the first up/down state after a threshold move; thereafter count at most one reversal per minute when close retreats from the running high or rebounds from the running low by at least the fixed threshold
features.directional_change_count: integer reversal count after initial direction confirmation
features.directional_change_rank: strict-prior midrank of directional_change_count over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank<=0.25
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute close returns), strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.block_return: log(last close/first open) over eight hours
features.late_return: log(last close/open at D-2h) over final two hours
features.direction_confirmation: block return and late return have one strict nonzero sign
features.open_interest_start: exact BTCUSDT open_interest_binance period=5m value at D-24h
features.open_interest_end: exact BTCUSDT open_interest_binance period=5m value at D
features.open_interest_sponsorship: both endpoints finite and strictly positive; log(OI_D/OI_D-24h)>0
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior exact valid block ineligible; missing prior opportunity cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: volatility-scaled intrinsic-time directional reversal scarcity with causal OI sponsorship

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no formula, rank, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
